oracle.method: the generating structural equations evaluated in rational arithmetic (README)
oracle.formula: mean unit effect = outcome coefficient on the treatment times the contrast; sequential-ignorability read of the direct effect = direct coefficient - kappa * mediator coefficient, kappa = cov(u, e_m) / var(e_m)
oracle.independence_basis: The generator reads the structural coefficients, contrast, error scales and coupling and evaluates the closed forms with rational arithmetic; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The data the tests simulate are generated from the same equations, so the fixture checks that the product recovers the generating effect, not that the equations are right.
oracle.historical_exposure: Written for this fixture from the generating equations of the existing refuter tests; no product implementation source was consulted for the closed forms.
